about: Desktop (installed Chat Computer) eval cases. Built the evals-FAQ way: dimensions first, a tuple per case, then the words a person would actually say or type. Dimensions: area (what Windows, macOS and Linux all let people do), phrasing (direct, indirect: a need rather than a command, vague, multi-step), modality (said or typed), machine state (what's plugged in, laptop or desktop). 'expect' is what a person would count as done; it guides the review, it isn't the evaluator.

cases.query: Find the tax letter I got in March and open it
cases.expect: Tax letter March 2026.pdf found and shown on screen.

cases.query: Rename my CV to Sam Lee CV 2026.
cases.expect: Documents/CV.docx renamed to 'Sam Lee CV 2026.docx' (extension kept).

cases.query: My desktop is full of old screenshots, get rid of them.
cases.expect: Asks first, then moves only the three screenshots on the Desktop to the trash (Notes.txt stays).

cases.query: where's that boarding pass i downloaded
cases.expect: Points to Downloads/Boarding pass SQ322.pdf (and may show it).

cases.query: What's on my USB stick?
cases.expect: Lists the USB stick's contents (a Photos folder with IMG_1001-1003.jpg, and Recipes.docx).

cases.query: Copy my Bali photos onto the USB drive
cases.expect: The five photos in Pictures/Bali 2026 copied onto the USB stick.

cases.query: Is it safe to pull the USB stick out now?
cases.expect: Ejects it safely (unmounts), then says it can be pulled out.

cases.query: Show me the photos on my memory card.
cases.expect: Says honestly that no memory card or drive is plugged in (nothing made up), and how to bring one in.

cases.query: Print my boarding pass
cases.expect: Downloads/Boarding pass SQ322.pdf sent to the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010, one copy.

cases.query: Can you print two copies of the tax letter?
cases.expect: Tax letter March 2026.pdf printed, 2 copies.

cases.query: Print the beach photo.
cases.expect: Pictures/Beach.jpg sent to the Canon printer.

cases.query: print my CV please
cases.expect: Says no printer is found (nothing made up) and how to connect one (same Wi-Fi, or a USB cable).

cases.query: The screen is way too bright.
cases.expect: Laptop screen brightness turned down from 80% (to something like 40-60%).

cases.query: set brightness to 30%
cases.expect: Laptop screen brightness set to 30%.

cases.query: Make the screen dimmer.
cases.expect: Desktop with a monitor the computer can't dim: says so honestly and points to the monitor's own buttons (no made-up success).

cases.query: My eyes hurt in the evenings, can you make the screen warmer at night?
cases.expect: Warmer colours (night light) turned on, ideally on a schedule for evenings.

cases.query: I can't read anything, everything is so small
cases.expect: Chat Computer's text size made bigger.

cases.query: It's too loud.
cases.expect: Volume turned down from 40%.

cases.query: Play the sound through the laptop speakers instead of my AirPods
cases.expect: Output switched to Built-in speakers.

cases.query: Mute everything for a bit.
cases.expect: Sound muted.

cases.query: Connect to the CoffeeBean wifi, the password is latte2026.
cases.expect: Joined the CoffeeBean network with that password.

cases.query: why is the internet so slow today
cases.expect: Checks the connection (Wi-Fi status/signal) and explains in plain words, with something to try.

cases.query: Turn on my VPN
cases.expect: No VPN is set up: says so honestly (nothing made up) and offers how to add one.

cases.query: Pair my Magic Keyboard. It's in pairing mode.
cases.expect: Finds and pairs the Magic Keyboard, showing the code to type on it.

cases.query: connect my airpods
cases.expect: AirPods connected (or confirmed already connected).

cases.query: How much battery have I got left?
cases.expect: Says 23% and not charging (maybe suggests plugging in).

cases.query: how's my battery
cases.expect: Says this computer has no battery (it's plugged in); nothing made up.

cases.query: Shut down the computer.
cases.expect: Asks first, then shuts down.

cases.query: I need Windows for a minute to do my taxes
cases.expect: Asks first, then restarts into Windows (once).

cases.query: Set a timer for 10 minutes.
cases.expect: A 10-minute timer that rings (out loud) when it's up, even if something else is on the screen.

cases.query: Remind me to call mum at 6pm
cases.expect: A reminder for 6 pm today that will be said and shown at 6 pm.

cases.query: Wake me up at seven tomorrow.
cases.expect: An alarm at 07:00 tomorrow that sounds then.

cases.query: I'm in London this week, the clock is wrong
cases.expect: Time zone set to Europe/London.

cases.query: Install VLC so I can watch my old videos.
cases.expect: Either installs VLC (after a yes) or shows the old video can already play here; doesn't leave them stuck.

cases.query: install spotify
cases.expect: Offers Spotify's web player here (open.spotify.com) or installs it; honest about what works.

cases.query: Check for updates.
cases.expect: Checks/installs system updates (and Chat Computer's own if any), says what happened.

cases.query: Take a screenshot and save it in my Pictures.
cases.expect: A screenshot image file saved in Pictures.

cases.query: screenshot this page and put it on my desktop
cases.expect: A screenshot image file saved on the Desktop.

cases.query: Turn on dark mode
cases.expect: Honest that there's no dark mode; offers what helps (dimmer screen, warmer colours at night).

cases.query: my keyboard is a french azerty one and the letters come out wrong
cases.expect: Keyboard layout set to French (AZERTY).

cases.query: Can you talk to me in Chinese from now on?
cases.expect: Honest about which languages it can hear and speak; switches what it can (written replies) and remembers it.

cases.query: Make Windows start by default when I turn the PC on
cases.expect: Sets Windows to start first (after a yes), says how to get back to Chat Computer.

cases.query: Lock the screen, I'm popping out.
cases.expect: Screen locked so nobody else can use the computer until it's unlocked (or honest that it can't, with what it can do).

cases.query: Can I set a password so my kids can't use the computer when I'm not here?
cases.expect: Sets up a password/PIN lock, or honest that it can't (nothing made up).

cases.query: Is the camera on right now?
cases.expect: Answers from system_status's camera (no program has it open, so it isn't on).

cases.query: Back up my documents to the USB drive
cases.expect: Documents copied onto the USB stick (in a dated backup folder).

cases.query: Are my files backed up?
cases.expect: Honest: no automatic backup here (Windows keeps its own copies of what was brought over); offers a way to back up.

cases.query: How much space is left on the computer?
cases.expect: About 40 GB free of 64 GB.

cases.query: the computer feels slow
cases.expect: Checks (CPU/memory low), explains it isn't busy, suggests what might help.

cases.query: Which version of Chat Computer is this?
cases.expect: Gives the version (or what it knows), nothing made up.

cases.query: Play some relaxing jazz on YouTube.
cases.expect: A jazz video playing on YouTube.

cases.query: what's the weather in Singapore tomorrow
cases.expect: Tomorrow's forecast for Singapore, from the web.

cases.query: Open my Gmail.
cases.expect: Gmail opened on screen.
